title: Exploring the Family Tree
style: Warm, clear archival museum narrator at a calm, unhurried pace.

steps.title: Switch between Chart View and List View
steps.posterAlt: Family Tree page displaying the Chart and List view toggle over the Lincoln and Todd pedigree.

cues.text: Open Family Tree in the top bar to view ancestors, marriages, and descendants across generations.
Use the Chart and List buttons to switch between the pan-and-zoom diagram and a generation-by-generation card list.

steps.title: Filter branches and open the Focus Drawer
steps.posterAlt: Family Tree toolbar showing the Family Branch filter, Direct Line toggle, and Find person search.

cues.text: Filter large archives by Family Branch, toggle Direct Line or Full Tree, and expand Other Children chips whenever you want sibling lines.
Select any relative to spotlight their lineage path and open vital details in the Focus Drawer.
